text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The PC left behind by the Legendary 
Trainer"? The hell is that? What a load of 
crap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur peered at the online auction 
screen I was looking at and knitted her 
brows.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I doubt an old clunker like this will 
even run. Besides, there's no way a 
legendary figure's PC would go for junk 
prices."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if I take it apart, there's nothing 
useful inside. Total waste of money.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The description for the PC says, 'Per my 
husband's will, we wish for an active 
Trainer to have this.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I smiled wryly, but I was still curious. 
Besides, at this price, even if it's a 
scam, I can just laugh it off as a funny 
story.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Stop doing pointless crap, would 
ya?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur spat out the words. If I had 
said there was romance in it, he probably 
would have been even more exasperated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You seriously bought it? ...Wait, of 
course it doesn't work, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No adapter either? There's no way 
there's an official one, and the 
voltage... nah, forget it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's rust here and there, and probably 
inside too... Hard to say if the data is 
even intact... Huh? What's that? A memo?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A note included alongside the PC. Judging 
by how slightly yellowed the paper is, it 
was likely written by the PC's owner—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems to have been written by the 
"Legendary Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was all that was written on the note. 
Considering they explained they wanted an 
active Trainer to have it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the future... for the Umamusume 
chasing their dreams, she might have left 
these records behind to aid them in their 
training.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's got some incredible data in it

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Can't say I'm expecting much. I mean, if 
someone's a real 'legend,' their 
achievements would be recorded everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if there is classified information, 
someone is bound to have analyzed it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you're gonna say it has 
'romance' or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I freeze and fall silent in shock, 
Air Shakur spits out a single word.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How pointless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to talk back, I scratched my head. 
I had hoped it would just turn into a 
laughing matter, but at the very least—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur let out an exaggerated sigh, 
grabbed her laptop, and walked out of the 
Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, it killed some time, at least.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It should boot up without any problems. 
The rest is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur paid an unexpected visit late 
at night. To my surprise, she had repaired 
that PC and brought it over.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut up. You're smothering me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there was only one video 
inside. Didn't watch what was on it, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the video with excitement. After 
waiting a moment for the video player to 
load... the video finally starts playing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the monitor, an elderly man was smiling 
gently. He then began recounting his days 
as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"I have walked alongside Umamusume for a 
long time. Though in the end, I never did 
reach my dream—"

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"The girl I trained told me. Not a single 
thing was ever in vain. All those days 
chasing after our dreams were..."

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"That the journey itself was something 
truly precious..."

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"‘Therefore, even if the road ahead is 
uncertain, I am sure that your... that all 
of your paths, and the journey itself, 
will be precious and dazzling.’"

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I wonder if this will actually be 
useful. Ah, man... but I really wanted to 
be a legendary Trainer who'd be talked 
about for generations to come."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After voicing just a tiny hint of regret 
at the end, the video concluded."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...The process, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, I dunno why she made a whole video. 
A letter would've done just fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly can't be called valuable 
data. It reads merely like a trainer 
recounting their memories. However...
choice_data_list:
Maybe I wanted to leave it behind in my 
own voice.

Maybe I wanted to leave it behind in my 
own voice, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice sounded so happy. Her 
expression, too. It wasn't something 
etched sharply into memory, but it left a 
soft, lingering warmth in my chest—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Pointless after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It ain't logical at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words were curt as usual, but there 
was a subtle warmth to her tone.
